name.purpose: The h1 only, once, at the top of the sheet; 20pt in print.

label.purpose: Every section heading, sentence-case foreground sans; weight alone separates it from body.

body.purpose: Prose, list titles (weight 500), skill values, footer.

body-small.purpose: The artist line inside the music tile.

mono.purpose: Dates, durations, places, stacks, the email, contact links, tile caption values. Muted by default.

mono-control.purpose: Text inside dock and copy buttons, the skip link, the contribution caption.

shadows.name: dock-float
shadows.purpose: Only on the fixed pill dock, because it is the only element that floats over content.

shadows.name: live-halo
shadows.purpose: The 3px ember-soft ring around the 6px live dot; a halo, not a shadow.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Exponential-out easing for the clock second hand (200ms) and tile transform (600ms).

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Colour and background fades on dock and copy buttons.

motion.name: theme-fade
motion.purpose: Body background and colour when the theme toggles; tile border-color on hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every transition and animation is disabled and smooth scroll is off.

schemes.name: light
schemes.note: Chosen by the dock toggle, stored in localStorage, applied before first paint; falls back to prefers-color-scheme.

schemes.name: print
schemes.note: White ground, black foreground, #444 muted, #bbb / #999 hairlines, light ember; widgets, dock and activity removed.

components.name: Dock

narrative.overview:
The page is a single sheet of near-black paper read top to bottom like a CV, and it prints as one. Every section is a plain label above a ruled list; the type is small, the column is narrow, and nothing on the sheet asks for attention except the things that are actually alive. Those live things sit in one row of small working instruments under the intro (a ticking Copenhagen clock, a Last.fm now-playing card, ) and a year of real GitHub contributions further down. Proof is shown as working things, not claimed.

Density is editorial and quiet: 15px Geist Sans body with generous 1.6 leading, 12.5px Geist Mono for every fact that is a date, a duration, a stack or a control. The build rejects the loud portfolio hero, decorative gradients, the card grid, and the transit line of the previous build. Depth comes from one tonal step (ground to surface) and 1px hairlines; the only shadow in the system is under the floating dock.

Colour is a discipline rather than a palette. One ember accent exists and is spent only on live state: the second hand, the "now" dot beside a current role or a playing track, the disease nodes in the graph, the hottest contribution cells, text selection and the focus ring. A light scheme and a print scheme re-map every token so the same structure survives on white paper.
keyCharacteristics: One 680px column, centred, no sidebar and no grid of cards.
Two type voices only: Geist Sans for prose and labels, Geist Mono for metadata and controls.
Ruled lists (1px hairline top and bottom) carry every section; widget tiles are the only bordered, rounded surfaces.
One accent, ember, reserved for things that are live right now.
Three schemes (dark, light, print) driven by the same custom properties; dark is the default.
Motion is confined to the instruments: the clock ticks, the graph settles and follows the pointer; everything else is a 150–200ms colour fade.

rules.name: The Live-Only Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember marks something that is true right now: a second hand, a playing track, a current role, a commit this year, a hot graph node. It never colours a heading, a link, a button at rest, or decoration. If it is not live, it is foreground or muted.

rules.name: The Two-Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px hairlines at exactly two strengths: hairline for rules and resting borders, hairline-strong for hover, the dock chrome and graph links. No other border colours exist.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: If a string is a date, a duration, a place, a stack, an address or a control label, it is Geist Mono at 12.5px and muted. Prose never goes mono; data never goes sans.

rules.name: The No-Display Rule
rules.body: There is no display size. The name is 18px; everything else is 15px or smaller. New surfaces do not introduce a larger heading.

rules.name: The One-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The dock is the only element that casts a shadow, because it is the only element that floats. Tiles, lists and buttons stay flat; their depth is a border change.

dos: Do keep every section as a plain 15px weight-500 label over a ruled list; add a section, not a card, when content grows.
Do set dates, durations, places, stacks and control text in Geist Mono at 12.5px muted (12px inside controls).
Do reach for hairline first and hairline-strong only for hover, chrome and graph links.
Do spend ember only on live state, and keep the 6px live dot as the marker for "now".
Do add new widgets as 200px-tall, 14px-radius surface tiles in the widget row, with a muted caption pinned to the bottom.
Do re-map new colours in all three schemes (dark root, [data-theme="light"], @media print) and read them through custom properties, including inside canvas.
Do confine motion to instruments and 150–200ms colour fades, and honour prefers-reduced-motion (all transitions and animations off).
donts: Don't introduce a hero, a display size, or any heading larger than the 18px name.
Don't set section labels in uppercase, tracked caps, or as eyebrows; they are sentence-case foreground sans.
Don't use ember for links, headings, buttons at rest, or decoration.
Don't add shadows to tiles, lists or buttons; the dock is the only floating element.
Don't box list content in cards or add vertical rules; lists are separated by horizontal hairlines only.
Don't underline links at rest; underline appears on hover only.
Don't use icon fonts or glyph characters; icons are 14px inline SVG outlines at 1.4 stroke.
